aliases: ムーンオンザステージ
official_definition: Moon On The Stage - (When Attacks) You can Advent a "Kanzaki Mitsuki" from your Hand onto this Spirit. Or, you can put one "Stage Style" family "Kanzaki Mitsuki" from your Hand to your Removed Zone. When you've done so, return this Spirit to your Hand and summon the card you put in your Removed Zone, without paying the cost.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Moon On The Stage] or [Moon On The Stage: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Moon On The Stage]", "give [Moon On The Stage]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
